preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 3 and 100000.
The angle a must be between 1 and 180 degrees.

postconditions.expression: stdout in {f'{v1} {v2} {v3}' for v1 in range(1, n+1) for v2 in range(1, n+1) for v3 in range(1, n+1) if v1 != v2 and v2 != v3 and v1 != v3}
postconditions.description: The output must consist of three distinct vertices v1, v2, v3 from the polygon.
The angle formed by vertices v1, v2, v3 must be as close as possible to the angle a.
